name: agent-file-migration
body: The migration of a repo's local `.opencode/agents/**` files across a move of the distribution boundary. When a distributed agent shares a name with a local file in a repo, the repo holds a duplicate; `apg init` reports the duplicate loudly while deleting nothing; the user removes the local copy by hand. The layout-upgrade guide (`~/.config/opencode/lib/apg-upgrade.md`) documents the migration; removal of the local copy stays a manual act. The distribution boundary moves across releases while a repo's local files persist.
